en: Connect external coding Agents to the live editor for selection-aware edits, rendered pages and exports.
Improved on-demand workspace files, document history, saving and cancellation, with matching native runtimes.
zh-CN: 连接外部编程 Agent，读取实时选区、精确编辑、查看渲染页面并导出文档。
改进工作区按需读取、文档历史、保存和取消处理，并提供匹配的原生运行时。
